acceptance_oracle: A page-reading tool must explicitly declare a bounded run page budget and receive a host-owned permit before each page fetch. An undeclared or exhausted budget prevents the next fetch and records only the limit, count, and stable stop code in durable run history.

red_observation.result: FAIL as expected before implementation: run() rejected max_pages; an undeclared page consume became generic FAILED rather than a bounded stop.

implementation: AgentRuntime accepts an optional max_pages run declaration bounded to 1..100.
A thread-safe host PageBudget grants one permit immediately before each handler page fetch; no permit exists if a limit was not declared.
Budget-required and exhausted outcomes stop the run as LIMIT_REACHED and persist max_pages/pages_consumed with stable result codes. Tool output and page values are not copied into traces.
The agent area contract documents how a page-reading handler must consume permits.
